headline: Stlican Shelf, Fisherman's Row Blaze Anew Overnight
war_summary: Since the evening filing the wire has shifted, with Stlican Shelf quickening to eight changes in two hours and thirty-three on the day about the Pale House, Vulpine Watch and the Old Mourn, latest a quarter-hour before midnight, standing six Warden, two Colonial and one destroyed, while Fisherman's Row shows six changes in two hours and thirty-six on the day about Eidolo and Black Well, latest at the filing hour, standing one Warden, seven Colonial and one destroyed. Godcrofts adds six changes in two hours, Farranac Coast three and Mooring County three about the Wind Hills and Wiccwalk, latest near eleven o'clock, still eleven Warden to one Colonial. Linn Mercy and Stonecradle, so lively at dusk, record no change in two hours, last turning near half-past eight, with Stonecradle still divided five to four. Weathered Expanse shows two changes in two hours and twenty-nine on the day about Frostmarch and Crow's Nest amid day tolls above thirteen thousand Colonial and sixteen thousand Warden, and Nevish Line reports sharp losses without a recorded base change on day two hundred seventy-two.
